title: Simple and intuitive
body: App looks great and having the free widget is awesome. It would be nice if there was more content in the explore part.
author: Kartrak

title: Nice
body: I like it because makes me be more organised. The free version doesn’t have a limit to the habits you can create, and that is great. Very complete. So far, no complaints.
author: beaavila

title: I love the App
body: Just a recommendation to check an error: when you don’t have the App opened in background, the widget simply doesn’t open the app if you click on it. You need to have the app in background to be able to open it by clicking on the widget.
author: Qualquer1DeNós
